title: Exact Evaluation of sin(5*pi/12)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the exact radical value of \sin(5\pi/12) using a trigonometric addition formula.

steps.title: Decompose 5*pi/12 as a Sum of Special Angles
steps.why: 3*pi/12 = pi/4 and 2*pi/12 = pi/6 are standard special angles.

steps.title: Apply the Sine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Expand using sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B.
steps.why: The sine addition formula expresses sin(pi/4 + pi/6) in terms of known ratios.

steps.title: Substitute Exact Values and Simplify
steps.explanation: Multiply the fractions and combine over the common denominator 4 (note also that sin(5*pi/12) = cos(pi/2 - 5*pi/12) = cos(pi/12)).
